arabicExcerpts.text: كِتَٰبٞ فُصِّلَتۡ ءَايَٰتُهُۥ قُرۡءَانًا عَرَبِيّٗا لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا فَأَعۡرَضَ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ
وَقَالُواْ قُلُوبُنَا فِيٓ أَكِنَّةٖ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُونَآ إِلَيۡهِ وَفِيٓ ءَاذَانِنَا وَقۡرٞ وَمِنۢ بَيۡنِنَا وَبَيۡنِكَ حِجَابٞ فَٱعۡمَلۡ إِنَّنَا عَٰمِلُونَ
قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٞ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمۡ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ فَٱسۡتَقِيمُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُوهُۗ وَوَيۡلٞ لِّلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ هُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُونٖ
۞قُلۡ أَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَكۡفُرُونَ بِٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَتَجۡعَلُونَ لَهُۥٓ أَندَادٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ مِن فَوۡقِهَا وَبَٰرَكَ فِيهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيهَآ أَقۡوَٰتَهَا فِيٓ أَرۡبَعَةِ أَيَّامٖ سَوَآءٗ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
ثُمَّ ٱسۡتَوَىٰٓ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٞ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلۡأَرۡضِ ٱئۡتِيَا طَوۡعًا أَوۡ كَرۡهٗا قَالَتَآ أَتَيۡنَا طَآئِعِينَ
فَقَضَىٰهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمَٰوَاتٖ فِي يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَأَوۡحَىٰ فِي كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ أَمۡرَهَاۚ وَزَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَحِفۡظٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيرُ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡعَلِيمِ
فَإِنۡ أَعۡرَضُواْ فَقُلۡ أَنذَرۡتُكُمۡ صَٰعِقَةٗ مِّثۡلَ صَٰعِقَةِ عَادٖ وَثَمُودَ

إِذۡ جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلرُّسُلُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ أَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوٓاْ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَۖ قَالُواْ لَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةٗ فَإِنَّا بِمَآ أُرۡسِلۡتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ

فَأَمَّا عَادٞ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ ٱلۡحَقِّ وَقَالُواْ مَنۡ أَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةًۖ أَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُمۡ هُوَ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۖ وَكَانُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُونَ
فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيحٗا صَرۡصَرٗا فِيٓ أَيَّامٖ نَّحِسَاتٖ لِّنُذِيقَهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡخِزۡيِ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَخۡزَىٰۖ وَهُمۡ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيۡنَٰهُمۡ فَٱسۡتَحَبُّواْ ٱلۡعَمَىٰ عَلَى ٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَأَخَذَتۡهُمۡ صَٰعِقَةُ ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلۡهُونِ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ

mainSubject.label: Opening letters and revelation from Rahman-Rahim grounding a detailed Arabic Book for knowers; bashir-nadhir function met by majority turning away; claimed heart-coverings ear-deafness and partition answered by the Prophet's human likeness and revealed tawheed with istighfar; woe to associators who withhold zakah and deny the Hereafter against uninterrupted reward for believing doers; the creation sequence of earth in two days, mountains and sustenance in four, heaven as smoke commanded to come willingly, seven heavens in two days with inspired command and lamp-adornment as protection; the thunderbolt warning recalling Aad and Thamud whose messengers came before and after calling to exclusive worship; Aad's unjust arrogance in strength answered by the Creator's greater power and a screaming wind of disgrace; Thamud preferring blindness over guidance seized by humiliating thunderbolt while believers who feared Allah were saved

Revelation traced to the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
A Book whose verses are detailed, an Arabic Quran for a people who know
Its function as giver of good tidings and warner, met by most turning away without hearing
Their claim of heart-coverings, ear-deafness and a partition, with mutual working declared
The Prophet's human likeness and revealed oneness of God, with the straight course and forgiveness-seeking commanded and woe to associators
Associators described as withholding zakah and disbelieving in the Hereafter
Believing doers of righteous deeds promised an uninterrupted reward
Challenge on disbelieving in the Creator of the earth in two days while attributing equals, named Lord of the worlds
Firmly set mountains, blessing and determined sustenance in four days for those who ask
Direction to the heaven while smoke, commanding it and the earth to come willingly or by compulsion, answered willingly
Completion as seven heavens in two days with inspired command, lamp-adornment and protection as the determination of the Mighty Knowing
Warning of a thunderbolt like that of Aad and Thamud if they turn away
Messengers coming before and after calling to worship none but Allah, answered by the claim that angels would have been sent
Aad's unjust arrogance and strength-boast answered by the Creator's greater strength, while they rejected the signs
A screaming wind sent during days of misfortune to taste disgrace in this world, with the Hereafter more disgracing and no help
Thamud guided but preferring blindness, seized by the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment for their earnings
Those who believed and feared Allah saved from that seizure

notes: Wave 6 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the saving of believers from Thamud's thunderbolt (18) before the enemies-gathering scene opens (19); P2 ends with the angelic accommodation promise (32); P3 runs from the best-speech question through the individual-recompense principle (33-46); P4 begins with Hour-knowledge exclusivity and closes with the encompassing-witness affirmation (47-54).
